source_policy.public_dataset: pin immutable revision, item ID, license/notice, audio SHA-256, and gold transcript; no public-license claim without item-level audit
source_policy.local_consented_read: requires explicit non-content consent_id and bounded retention/deletion record; one continuous utterance per item; no bystanders
source_policy.smoke_examples: never count repeated, sliced, concatenated, or official Paraformer smoke WAV examples as quality items

item_template.gold_transcript: required exact source text or read-sheet line
item_template.source_revision: required immutable release/commit or N/A for local read-sheet
item_template.source_item_id: required for public dataset or N/A for local read-sheet
item_template.consent_id: required for local capture; public permission record for public audio
item_template.audio_path: separately admitted bounded benchmark folder only

validation.missing_assets_or_consent_result: PENDING or BLOCKED, never synthetic PASS
